title: Fox Mandal & Associates, Chandhiok & Mahajan act on BigEndian Semiconductors pre-Series A fundraise
description: BigEndian Semiconductors Private Limited has raised $9 million through a Pre-Series A CCPS fundraise led by IAN Alpha Fund, with participation from Vertex Ventures SEA and India, IvyCap Ventures and angel investors.Fox Mandal & Associates advised BigEndian Semiconductors on this fundraise.
